svg.text: Rails: two 2600 mm lengths of 30 x 30 x 2 aluminium channel,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open sides facing each other; screw to the booth front with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M6 screws at 400 pitch, the lower rail 845 to 875 mm up, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upper rail 1525 to 1555 mm up, from 0 to 2600 along the booth

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front (running 150 mm past its right end). End stop each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sash: one panel 1250 x 650 of 1.5 mm galvanised sheet with all

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges folded 15 mm; two handles; edges run inside the channels.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: There is only one sash, so only one opening is open at a time:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over opening 2 to press, over opening 1 to cool and unload.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the sash slides end to end with one hand and covers each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: opening with at least 25 mm to spare on both sides.
